Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the final decision before completion), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Brooklyn College is part of the State University of New York (SUNY). The WebSurfer had just confirmed in the previous turn that Brooklyn College is a member unit of the City University of New York (CUNY). The Planner hallucinated the wrong university system (SUNY instead of CUNY) in its final reasoning and answer.
